rows.sentence: Based on `doc.txt`, here is what the document says:
rows.label: no_rad
rows.rationale: This introduces the answer and makes no substantive claim about mpox.

rows.sentence: "Mpox (formerly known as monkeypox) is a disease caused by infection with a virus, known as Monkeypox virus.
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The document explicitly gives both the former disease name and the name of the virus that causes it.

rows.sentence: This virus is part of the same family as the virus that causes smallpox." (doc.txt)
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The document explicitly places the two viruses in the same family.

rows.sentence: "Mpox is a zoonotic disease, meaning it can be spread between animals and people.
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The document identifies mpox as zoonotic and explains that it can spread between animals and people.

rows.sentence: It is endemic, or found regularly, in parts of Central and West Africa." (doc.txt)
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The document identifies parts of Central and West Africa as places where mpox is regularly found.

rows.sentence: "The first human case of mpox was recorded in 1970, in what is now the Democratic Republic of the Congo." (doc.txt)
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The document gives the same year and location for the first recorded human case.

rows.sentence: The World Health Organization "renamed the disease in 2022," though "The virus that causes it still has its historic name." (doc.txt)
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The document confirms that WHO renamed the disease in 2022 while the virus retained its historic name.

rows.sentence: Is it currently spreading?
rows.label: no_rad
rows.rationale: This heading asks a question rather than asserting a fact.

rows.sentence: "In 2022, mpox spread around the world." (doc.txt)
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The document explicitly dates worldwide spread to 2022.

rows.sentence: "Clade I is responsible for the current rise of cases in Central and Eastern Africa." (doc.txt)
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The document explicitly attributes the current rise in those regions to clade I.

rows.sentence: "Clade II is the type that caused the global outbreak that began in 2022." (doc.txt)
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The document identifies clade II as the cause of the global outbreak that began in 2022.

rows.sentence: The document does not state whether mpox is spreading outside these described situations beyond the "current rise of cases in Central and Eastern Africa."
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The document identifies a current rise only in Central and Eastern Africa. Its other geographic statements describe endemic presence or the global outbreak that began in 2022, without establishing whether spread is currently occurring elsewhere.

rows.sentence: "People with mpox often get a rash, along with other symptoms.
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The document explicitly describes a rash as a common symptom that occurs alongside other symptoms.

rows.sentence: The rash will go through several stages, including scabs, before healing." (doc.txt)
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The document explicitly says the rash goes through multiple stages, including scabbing, before healing.

rows.sentence: "Although cases of mpox are not life-threatening, some people may be more likely to get severely ill, including People with severely weakened immune systems, Children younger than 1, People with a history of eczema, People who are pregnant." (doc.txt)
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The document's severe-disease section makes this statement and lists all four groups.

rows.sentence: "Historically, clade I caused higher numbers of severe illnesses than clade II, with up to 10% of people dying from it.
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The document gives the same historical comparison and upper death rate for clade I.

rows.sentence: Recent outbreaks have seen much lower death rates of about 1-3.3%." (doc.txt)
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The document gives this lower death-rate range for recent outbreaks in its discussion of clade I.

rows.sentence: "Infections from clade II mpox are generally less severe.
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The document explicitly describes clade II infections as generally less severe.

rows.sentence: More than 99.9% of people survive." (doc.txt)
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The document gives this survival figure in its discussion of clade II.

rows.sentence: "There are several ways you can protect yourself and others from mpox:" (doc.txt)
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The prevention section explicitly states that there are several ways to protect oneself and others.

rows.sentence: "Getting vaccinated.
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The document lists vaccination as a prevention measure.

rows.sentence: Check with your healthcare provider to find out if the mpox vaccine is recommended for you." (doc.txt)
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The document gives this same advice about checking whether vaccination is recommended.

rows.sentence: "Avoiding close, skin-to-skin contact with people who have a rash that looks like mpox." (doc.txt)
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The document lists avoiding this type of contact as a prevention measure.

rows.sentence: "Avoiding contact with materials that a person with mpox has used, including sharing eating utensils and cups, and handling their bedding or clothing." (doc.txt)
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The document recommends avoiding these materials and gives the same examples.

rows.sentence: "If you do get mpox, isolate at home, and cover lesions and wear a mask if you must be around others." (doc.txt)
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The document gives the same instructions on isolation, covering lesions, and wearing a mask.

rows.sentence: "If you are in an area of Western or Central Africa where mpox occurs regularly, avoid contact with live or dead wild animals." (doc.txt)
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The document gives this advice with the same geographic condition and specifies both live and dead wild animals.
